stemMd: Parallel lines $\ell$ and $m$ are intersected by a transversal $t$. Two interior angles on the same side of $t$, one at line $\ell$ and one at line $m$, measure $(3x + 10)^\circ$ and $(5x - 30)^\circ$. What is the measure, in degrees, of the larger of these two angles?
explanationMd:
When parallel lines are cut by a transversal, two interior angles on the **same side** of the transversal are supplementary: their measures add to $180^\circ$. (It is alternate interior angles, on opposite sides, that are equal.)

$$(3x + 10) + (5x - 30) = 180$$

$$8x - 20 = 180 \;\Rightarrow\; 8x = 200 \;\Rightarrow\; x = 25$$

The angles measure $3(25) + 10 = 85^\circ$ and $5(25) - 30 = 95^\circ$, so the larger is $95^\circ$.

Check: $85 + 95 = 180$.

The tempting error is to set the two expressions equal, which gives $x = 20$ and two $70^\circ$ angles; their sum is only $140^\circ$, so they cannot be same-side interior angles.

distractorRationale.c: This is the smaller of the two angles, $3(25) + 10 = 85$. The question asks for the larger one, $95$.
distractorRationale.b: This sets the two expressions equal, as if the angles were alternate interior angles, giving $x = 20$ and $70^\circ$. Same-side interior angles are supplementary, not equal.
distractorRationale.a: This is the value of $x$, not an angle measure. Substitute $x = 25$ into each expression to find the angles.

accessibilityText: Parallel lines l and m are cut by transversal t. Two interior angles on the same side of t, one at each parallel line, measure 3 x plus 10 degrees and 5 x minus 30 degrees. What is the measure in degrees of the larger angle? The choices are 25, 70, 85 and 95.

provenance.notes: Original item. Uses the supplementary relationship of same-side interior angles; distractors come from the equal-angles error, the smaller angle, and stopping at x.

independentSolve.workingNotes: Same-side interior angles are supplementary: 8x - 20 = 180, x = 25, angles 85 and 95; larger is 95. 25 is x, 85 is the smaller angle, 70 sets them equal (x=20 gives 70). [A second, separate blind solve (blind-reviewer-wave8-sat-math-run1) reached the same answer: Same-side interior angles are supplementary: 8x - 20 = 180, x = 25, giving 85 and 95; larger is 95. 25 is x itself, 85 is the smaller angle, and 70 results from wrongly setting the angles equal (x = 20).]
